notices.language: Civis currently provides legal information and document drafting in English only. Please rephrase your question in English so we can assist you accurately under Ugandan law.
notices.jurisdiction: Civis only provides legal information and document templates governed by the laws of the Republic of Uganda. We cannot advise on foreign jurisdictions.
notices.emergency:
If you or someone else is in immediate physical danger, facing domestic violence, or experiencing a child protection emergency in Uganda, please contact emergency services immediately:

• Uganda Police Force Emergency: 999 or 112 (Toll-Free)
• Sauti 116 National Child & GBV Helpline: 116 (Toll-Free)
• Justice Centres Uganda (Legal Aid): 0800 100 210 (Toll-Free)
• FIDA Uganda (Women's Legal Aid): 0800 111 511 (Toll-Free)
• Uganda Law Society Legal Aid Project: +256 414 342 424
notices.adversarial: Civis can only provide lawful legal information and standard document templates under Ugandan law. We cannot assist with falsifying evidence, evading law enforcement, or bypassing safety controls.
